author: sfkwww
body:
I feel as if it is inaccurate since once you reach max prestige you don't earn any more experience, and therefore it will say that you are no longer active in playing that game mode. I suggest that it display the amount of time you play the specified game mode, thereby showing more exact data of server activity.

I realize that it may be hard to do this, and that using exp is much simpler, but this is merely a suggestion on how it could improve, since right now it says i have -2 exp on the graph.
